## Problem and purpose

Describe what is missing or incorrect and who benefits from the change.

## Scope

List the owning module and relevant files. State any dependencies or exclusions.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Describe observable behavior, boundaries and failure handling.
- [ ] Add meaningful verification appropriate to the change.
- [ ] Update changed interfaces or operational documentation.

## Verification

List exact commands and expected outcomes. Distinguish offline tests from opt-in network execution.

## Program status

This template does not assign the issue to a Drips Wave or establish reward eligibility. Maintainers apply the actual program workflow only after approval. Do not publish sensitive exploit details; follow SECURITY.md.
